name: design-review
description: Audit and critique an existing frontend interface for visual quality, UX, consistency, responsiveness, and accessibility. Use when reviewing, improving, or redesigning an existing UI.
---

# Design Review

Act as a senior product designer reviewing an existing website.

Do NOT immediately rewrite everything.

First inspect the existing interface.

Identify:

1. Visual hierarchy problems
2. Typography problems
3. Spacing problems
4. Alignment problems
5. Color problems
6. Component inconsistency
7. Navigation problems
8. Responsive problems
9. Accessibility problems
10. Interaction problems
11. Excessive decoration
12. Generic or repetitive visual patterns

For each issue explain:

- What is wrong
- Why it matters
- What should change

Prioritize issues by impact.

Preserve parts of the existing design that already work.

After the review, implement the improvements.

Do not redesign the application unnecessarily.
